items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: Manuel Mineta studied clarinet with Sam Dutre.

ctx.x: Yeah, his father was an old time. Did you ever hear him? No, I've never heard his father.
Well Manuel Mineta talks a lot about Manuel Mineta studied clarinet with Sam Dutre. We'd been on the boat years ago. Oh yeah. When Louie first started out in 18, 18 or so. Uh huh.
